comment:
* An immutable sequence of bytes. * *

Byte strings compare lexicographically as a sequence of unsigned bytes. That * is, the byte string {@code ff} sorts after {@code 00}. This is counter to the sort order of the * corresponding bytes, where {@code -1} sorts before {@code 0}. * *

Full disclosure: this class provides untrusted input and output streams with * raw access to the underlying byte array. A hostile stream implementation could keep a reference * to the mutable byte string, violating the immutable guarantee of this class. For this reason a * byte string's immutability guarantee cannot be relied upon for security in applets and other * environments that run both trusted and untrusted code in the same process. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static ByteString of(byte... data)
methods.comment: * Returns a new byte string containing a clone of the bytes of {@code data}.

methods.name: public static ByteString of(byte[] data, int offset, int byteCount)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new byte string containing a copy of {@code byteCount} bytes of {@code data} starting
   * at {@code offset}.

methods.name: public static ByteString encodeUtf8(String s)
methods.comment: Returns a new byte string containing the {@code UTF-8} bytes of {@code s}.

methods.name: public String utf8()
methods.comment: Constructs a new {@code String} by decoding the bytes as {@code UTF-8}.

methods.name: public String base64()
methods.comment: * Returns this byte string encoded as Base64. In violation of the * RFC, the returned string does not wrap lines at 76 columns.

methods.name: public ByteString md5()
methods.comment: Returns the MD5 hash of this byte string.

methods.name: public ByteString sha256()
methods.comment: Returns the SHA-256 hash of this byte string.

methods.name: public String base64Url()
methods.comment: * Returns this byte string encoded as URL-safe * Base64.

methods.name: public static ByteString decodeBase64(String base64)
methods.comment:
* Decodes the Base64-encoded bytes and returns their value as a byte string.
   * Returns null if {@code base64} is not a Base64-encoded sequence of bytes.

methods.name: public String hex()
methods.comment: Returns this byte string encoded in hexadecimal.

methods.name: public static ByteString decodeHex(String hex)
methods.comment: Decodes the hex-encoded bytes and returns their value a byte string.

methods.name: public static ByteString read(InputStream in, int byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads {@code count} bytes from {@code in} and returns the result.
   *
   * @throws java.io.EOFException if {@code in} has fewer than {@code count}
   *     bytes to read.

methods.name: public ByteString toAsciiLowercase()
methods.comment:
* Returns a byte string equal to this byte string, but with the bytes 'A'
   * through 'Z' replaced with the corresponding byte in 'a' through 'z'.
   * Returns this byte string if it contains no bytes in 'A' through 'Z'.

methods.name: public ByteString toAsciiUppercase()
methods.comment:
* Returns a byte string equal to this byte string, but with the bytes 'a'
   * through 'z' replaced with the corresponding byte in 'A' through 'Z'.
   * Returns this byte string if it contains no bytes in 'a' through 'z'.

methods.name: public ByteString substring(int beginIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns a byte string that is a substring of this byte string, beginning at the specified
   * index until the end of this string. Returns this byte string if {@code beginIndex} is 0.

methods.name: public ByteString substring(int beginIndex, int endIndex)
methods.comment:
* Returns a byte string that is a substring of this byte string, beginning at the specified
   * {@code beginIndex} and ends at the specified {@code endIndex}. Returns this byte string if
   * {@code beginIndex} is 0 and {@code endIndex} is the length of this byte string.

methods.name: public byte getByte(int pos)
methods.comment: Returns the byte at {@code pos}.

methods.name: public int size()
methods.comment: * Returns the number of bytes in this ByteString.

methods.name: public byte[] toByteArray()
methods.comment: * Returns a byte array containing a copy of the bytes in this {@code ByteString}.

methods.name: public void write(OutputStream out) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes the contents of this byte string to {@code out}.

methods.name: void write(Buffer buffer)
methods.comment: Writes the contents of this byte string to {@code buffer}.

methods.name: public boolean rangeEquals(int offset, ByteString other, int otherOffset, int byteCount)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the bytes of this in {@code [offset..offset+byteCount)} equal the bytes of
   * {@code other} in {@code [otherOffset..otherOffset+byteCount)}. Returns false if either range is
   * out of bounds.

methods.name: public boolean rangeEquals(int offset, byte[] other, int otherOffset, int byteCount)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the bytes of this in {@code [offset..offset+byteCount)} equal the bytes of
   * {@code other} in {@code [otherOffset..otherOffset+byteCount)}. Returns false if either range is
   * out of bounds.
